commitments.description: Make 100% of packaging recyclable by 2025 and design for recyclability.
Reach 5% recycled content in plastic packaging by 2025.

controversies.description: Brands Cadbury and Oreo flagged in beach-cleanup audits across Europe and South Asia.

wooby.headline: Mondelez makes Oreos and Cadbury — and a lot of crinkly wrappers.
wooby.narrative: Mondelez makes Oreos, Cadbury chocolate, Toblerone, and many other snacks. The shiny crinkly wrappers are very hard to recycle. Wooby would love a future where snack wrappers can be recycled or composted.
